admins.title: Administrators
admins.subtitle: Who has access to the control panel.
admins.makeMainText: {{name}} will become the main administrator. You will stay as a regular administrator and lose access to this section.
admins.ownerMissing: The main administrator has no document in the admins collection. Add yourself with “Add administrator” (your UID: {{uid}}) — the role cannot be transferred without it.
admins.loadErrorTitle: Could not load the administrator list
admins.loadErrorText: Check your internet connection and the Firestore rules, then try again.
admins.removeText: {{name}} will lose access to the control panel. Their Firebase Authentication account stays.
admins.hint: A new administrator must first sign up on the site or be created in Firebase Authentication. To change a name or email, remove the administrator and add them again.
admins.emptyText: Add the first administrator to give them access to the panel.
admins.deniedTitle: No access to the administrator list
admins.deniedText: Firestore rejected the request. Only the main administrator can see the list; also check that the current rules from firestore.rules are published in the Firebase Console.

form.title: Add administrator
form.uidHint: Copy the UID from the Firebase console: Authentication → Users, the User UID column.
form.name: Name

toast.error: Could not transfer the role. Make sure the administrator has a document in admins and try again.
toast.removeError: Could not remove the administrator. Please try again.
toast.denied: Not enough permissions: only the main administrator can manage administrators.
toast.protected: The main administrator and your own account cannot be removed.

errors.adminUidInvalid: The UID must not contain spaces or “/” (up to 128 characters)

errors.productSaveFailed: Could not save the product. Check your internet connection and try again.
